artifact_inventory.description: Historical Euclidean K=0 illustration; not a certificate for the general metric theorem

limitations: The proof concerns dynamic minimizing interpolations for 0<epsilon<=1. It does not certify the previous all-noise assertion. It uses EVI perturbation estimates rather than assuming a finite-dimensional potential Hessian formula. General displacement convexity is prior-known.
record_title: Uniform small-noise entropic K-convexity on compact RCD(K,infinity) spaces
